spans.s:
(उ) चञ्चु r. 1st cl. (चञ्चति)
To go, to move.

f. (-च्चा)
1 A mat, a stool, &c. made of reeds or basket work.
2 A puppet of grass or reeds, a man of straw.
E.
चञ्च to go, अच् aff.

mfn. (-ञ्चन्-ञ्चन्ती-ञ्चत्)
1 Going, moving.
2 Unsteady, shaking.
E.
चञ्च to go, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-त्कः-त्का-त्कं)
Trembling, moving.
E.
क्षञ्चत् the present participle of चञ्च as above, affix कन्.

f. (-री)
1 A bee.

m. (-कः)
A large black bee.
E.
चर to go, reduplicated, नुम् inserted, ईकन् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
1 Trembling, shaking, moving, unsteady.
2 Fickle, inconsiderate, inconstant, (unsteady, metaphorically.)
m. (-लः)
1 The wind.
2 A lecher, a libertine, a lover.
f. (-ला)
1

Lightning.
2

LAKṢMĪ or the goddess of fortune.
3 Longpepper.
E.
चल to go, in the reiterative form, नुम् inserted.

n. (-त्वं)
Fickleness, inconstancy, unsteadiness.
E.
चञ्चल, and त्व affix; also with तल् affix चञ्चलता.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Capricious, fickle, false hearted.
E.
चञ्चल, and हृदय the heart.

f. (-ञ्चुः)
A beak; also चञ्च.
m. (-ञ्चुः)
1 The castor oil plant.
2 A kind of potherb.
3 A deer.
E.
चञ्चु to go, to eat, affix उ.

f. (-ञ्चूः)
A beak: see चञ्चु, the affix being ऊ.

f. (-का)
A beak.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

m. (-भृत्)
A bird.
E.
चञ्चु a beak, and भृत् who possesses; also other similar compounds as चञ्चुमत्, &c.

mf. (-मान्-मती)
A bird.
E.
चञ्चु a beak, and मतुप् poss. aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Expert in, conversant with.
2 Going to repeatedly.
E.
चर to go, intensitive form, अच् aff.

m. (-चिः)
The tailor bird, (Sylvia sutoria.)
E.
चञ्चु a beak, and सूचि a needle; having a sharp-pointed beak; also with कन् added, चञ्चुसूचिक

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Following evil practices, behaving ill, addicted to wickedness.
E.
चर to go, intensitive form, शानच् aff.

n. (-ल्यं)
1 Tremulousness, unsteadiness.
2 Transitoriness.
E.
चञ्चल, and ष्यञ् aff.
